sourceNotes: Q1 and Q2 both refer to the small-left-colon contrast-enema image on source page 197; only one embedded image object is present and it is linked to both questions.
Q3 and Q5 have separate contrast-enema images on pages 198 and 200 respectively.

Q8 and Q9 stems mention X-rays, but the actual radiographs are absent from the rendered pages; the visible images are explanatory tables/illustrations and are not substituted for the missing question radiographs.
Q10 and Q11 likewise reference X-rays that are absent from current source page 204.
Q13 has an actual chest radiograph on page 205. Q14 and Q15 mention X-ray findings, but page 206 contains only explanatory graphics, so their question radiographs remain missing.

Q19 and Q20 explicitly say a picture was provided, but no question image is present on rendered source page 209; page 210 contains only an explanatory omphalocele-versus-gastroschisis comparison graphic.
Q23 source explicitly states that an abdominal X-ray was provided and was suggestive of functional constipation.
Q28 and Q29 use the same dermatitis-herpetiformis photograph on source page 216.
These extracted image bytes are not committed to this public repository; only source-page/hash metadata is committed.
